abstract: Can investor stewardship codes that call for coordinated activism be satisfied by an Investor Collective Action Organization (ICAO)? In an ICAO, investors work collectively, like a large shareholder, to monitor management and increase value. We analyze the endogenous formation of an ICAO and its equilibrium size, considering free-rider problems and coordination costs. While the ICAO overcomes free-rider problems among its members, it exacerbates them between the ICAO and solo activists. The benefit of joining an ICAO is hump-shaped in size. With moderate coordination costs, ICAO formation features multiple equilibria. Small changes in coordination costs significantly influence ICAO formation and activism. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: L. Yang thanks the support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grants 435-2021-0040, 435-2026-0060] and the Bank of Canada [Fellowship]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02975 .
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Collective Activism

abstract: Understanding whether political elites maintain advantages in accessing economic opportunities during market transitions is crucial for assessing the distributional consequences of market-oriented reforms. This study examines whether political status provides rural households with advantages in accessing production resources and income opportunities during China’s recent wave of marketization, and how these advantages vary with the degree of market development. Using three waves of the China Family Database spanning 2015–2019 and employing an instrumental variable approach, we find that political elites maintain persistent advantages in accessing economic opportunities. Relative to non-elites, cadre households exhibit 20.1 percentage points higher rates of receiving agricultural subsidies, 38.8 percentage points higher rates of owning agricultural machinery, and 9.7 percentage points greater likelihood of operating nonfarm businesses. As marketization advances, the sources of elite advantage shift from agriculture to commercial activities. While advantages in agricultural production weaken, reflecting reduced state-controlled resource allocation channels, advantages in business operations strengthen consistent with elites converting political capital into entrepreneurial opportunities. Our findings suggest that rural marketization in China reallocates rather than reduces opportunity gaps. This pattern indicates that even as market reforms diminish traditional avenues for political privilege, they simultaneously open new market-based opportunities that preserve elite advantage. These findings have broader implications for understanding how political power influences access to opportunities during market transitions in developing economies.

abstract: There is increasing evidence on regional variations in US Medicare health care utilization based on older patients who move. Yet moving for the elderly population is typically endogenous, and evidence is limited for younger populations. In this paper, we harness the mandatory migration of military personnel to estimate supply and demand factors in a system of care for younger enrollees in which military physicians are salaried and copayments and deductibles are negligible. Our preferred estimates imply that supply effects explain between one-half and two-thirds of overall regional variation. These variations cannot be explained by differences in quality of care, but appear consistent with location-specific differences in physician beliefs. title: Place-Based Variation in Health Care: Evidence from Mandatory Movers in the U.S. Military Health System

abstract: This paper explores responses to major trade policy shocks in the soybean futures market in 2025. Using an event‐study framework, we analyse short‐run movements in soybean futures prices, historical volatility, implied volatility and speculative positioning around three major policy shocks: the U.S. tariff announcement targeting China on February 1, the reciprocal tariff announcement on April 2, and Argentina's temporary suspension of soybean export taxes on September 22. Broader in scope, the April reciprocal tariff package was associated with the clearest and strongest response. Futures prices fell by about 6% within two trading days, while implied volatility rose sharply. Following the February announcement, implied volatility increased immediately and then receded, while downward repricing became evident only after China's retaliatory tariffs took effect, suggesting that uncertainty rose before the implications for U.S. export demand became clearer. Argentina's export‐tax suspension, by contrast, was followed by limited repricing, a later decline in implied volatility, and greater speculative positioning relative to commercial hedging needs. The cross‐event comparison suggests that the timing and composition of market adjustment vary with the scope, directness and subsequent evolution of each policy episode.

abstract: I revisit the factor decomposition methodology developed by Gürkaynak et al. (2005) and Swanson (2021) using the new U.S. Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (USMPD) provided by Acosta et al. (2025). I present evidence supporting a four-factor rather than three-factor decomposition and propose a procedure that structurally interprets the additional factor as an information factor. In particular, I demonstrate that the monetary policy surprises employed by Swanson (2021) yield three factors in pre-ZLB samples, with a fourth factor emerging following the Fed’s adoption of large-scale asset purchases. The suggested procedure has the merit that it preserves the well-established three-factor decomposition of Swanson (2021) while accommodating an additional information factor. The new evidence underlines that central bank announcements constitute high-dimensional communication events.
title: On the number of high-frequency surprise factors in U.S. monetary policy

abstract: The increasing integration of intermittent renewable energy sources poses challenges in balancing electricity generation and consumption. The vehicle-to-grid (V2G) concept, which utilizes pools of electric vehicles (EVs) as both energy sources and storage units, offers a potential solution. By charging and discharging batteries as required by the grid, V2G can help maintain grid stability by matching electricity production and consumption in real time. These services are contracted in balancing markets. This study explores the economic feasibility of EVs participating in balancing markets by incorporating real energy data, driving patterns, and current technical parameters. The findings suggest that providing balancing services with EVs can be economically viable under the existing regulatory framework, though it was not under the previous one. Profitability increases with the amount of time a vehicle is parked at home and eligible for balancing, generating annual profits of up to 881 €. Users can further increase their profits by giving up some flexibility of their driving schedules if market conditions demand it. A broad range of sensitivity tests suggests that profitability is severely affected by battery degradation costs and adequate distribution network infrastructure. The study identifies key market design elements critical to the successful implementation of V2G systems.
title: Steering profitability: How electricity balancing regulations drive V2G feasibility in Germany

abstract: This study examines the public evidence available for assessing Morocco's nuclear power decision readiness across the 19 infrastructure issues of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Milestones Approach. A documentary assessment separates established institutional foundations, evidence of preparatory activity, and matters that remain unverified. An author-developed Level 0–3 scale describes the maturity of the documented arrangements within their stated scope; it is neither an IAEA scoring system nor a test of Milestone 1 attainment. The assessment recognizes Morocco's previous infrastructure review and existing coordination, regulatory and research capabilities. It identifies important evidence needs concerning the current status of programme coordination, implementation of regulatory improvements, financing, workforce planning and long-term stewardship. Historical evidence of studies is retained without being treated as proof of present implementation. Governance-related evidence gaps are prominent in the reviewed record, but the analysis cannot establish that institutional constraints outweigh economic, technical or social constraints. The resulting roadmap links proposed actions to specific infrastructure issues and to reviewable decision outputs. Siting is presented solely as a framework for future investigation, without weights, scores or regional rankings. The policy implication is to update and independently review the national decision evidence before making further commitments, while retaining continuation, deferral and non-deployment as legitimate outcomes.
title: Morocco's nuclear option readiness (2026–2050): A governance-first approach aligned with the IAEA milestones framework

abstract: This paper replicates and augments the study of Ramzan et al. (2025), which investigates the drivers of energy poverty in Spain using a multivariate quantile-on-quantile regression framework. While the original study reports that renewable energy consumption (REN), green innovation (GIN), natural resource rents (RNT), and information globalization (IGL) reduce energy poverty, our replication identifies fundamental conceptual and empirical flaws that undermine these outcomes. A key issue concerns the use of access to electricity (AEP) as a proxy for energy poverty, despite Spain maintaining near-universal electricity access throughout the study period. Our replication shows that higher renewable energy consumption is often associated with lower AEP values, contrary to the positive relationship reported in the original study. Green innovation effects also vary across quantiles, with both positive and negative impacts, contrary to uniformly beneficial effects. Robustness tests confirm the replication findings. We further strengthen the analysis by employing “population unable to keep home adequately warm” (AEPN) as an alternative measure of energy poverty and by incorporating additional control variables. In contrast to Ramzan et al. (2025), the AEPN-based estimates suggest that renewable energy expansion does not uniformly reduce energy poverty and is associated with higher energy deprivation across several quantiles. The additional controls show that energy prices, energy intensity, urbanisation, and inequality also play an important role in shaping the distributional dynamics of energy poverty. The results imply that renewable energy policies alone may be insufficient to alleviate energy poverty unless accompanied by measures addressing affordability, energy prices, and household vulnerability.
title: Reassessing the evidence on Spain's energy poverty amid the green transition: A replication and augmentation

abstract: This paper conceptualizes political rallies as an informational signal rather than a pure mobilization device. Building on the pivotal voter model, we argue that the decision to hold a rally conveys localized information about electoral competitiveness, increasing voters’ perceived probability of being pivotal. When voters infer that an election is close, the incentive to turn out rises even in the absence of direct persuasion. Using county-level data from U.S. presidential elections between 2000 and 2016, we find that counties hosting rallies exhibit turnout rates approximately 1.55 percentage points higher than comparable counties. The effect is strongest in electorally competitive areas, consistent with a belief-updating mechanism rather than generalized enthusiasm. These findings highlight how campaign events influence participation by shaping voters’ perceptions of electoral stakes.
title: Campaign rallies and voter turnout: The role of electoral competitiveness

abstract: To what extent do identical workers in an industry benefit from productivity growth in the same industry? We study this question in the context of the UK auto industry which experienced a thirteen-fold increase in output per worker between 1980 and 2018. Over the same period, auto workers saw substantially stronger hourly wage growth than workers in other manufacturing industries. Controlling for unobserved worker heterogeneity, the auto wage premium over other manufacturing workers doubled from 8% in the 1980s to 17% in the 2010s, while the manufacturing premium over the rest of the economy remained roughly stable at 5%. Interpreted through the lens of a rent sharing model, we estimate that 63% of the increase in the raw firm-level auto wage premium can be accounted for by strong productivity growth. In contrast, differential bargaining power between auto workers cannot account for these changes.
title: An engine of (pay) growth? Productivity and wages in the UK auto industry

abstract: This paper focuses on finite-player incomplete information games where players may hold mutually inconsistent beliefs without a common prior. We introduce absolute continuity of beliefs, extending the classical notion of absolute continuity of information in Milgrom and Weber (1985), and prove that Bayesian equilibria exist in a broad class of games, including those with discontinuous payoffs. Examples illustrate the scope and implications of our findings.
title: Existence of Bayesian Equilibria in Incomplete Information Games without Common Priors

abstract: Sportsbooks offer promotional “free bets” that return profits if the bets win, but not the stake provided. These bets can be hedged to produce guaranteed profits. This paper shows how to value the guaranteed profit from these stake-not-returned free bets under a simple constant-margin pricing rule in which sportsbooks, on average, keep a fraction m of the money staked. The guaranteed hedged value is a nonlinear function of the free bet’s probability of winning, reaching a maximum when this probability is m ( 1 − m ) . Empirical evidence from odds on tennis bets confirms this prediction.
title: The economics of free bets

abstract: Rose and Spiegel (2011) identified a positive trade-promoting effect of hosting the Olympic Games, yet they did not account for multilateral resistance terms in their analysis, which are emphasized in the structural gravity model by Anderson and van Wincoop (2003). This paper revisits the trade effects of the Olympics using a nonparametric matching method developed by Chang and Lee (2011), analyzing a comprehensive gravity dataset encompassing 187 economies from 1950 to 2019. Our findings suggest that hosting the Olympics is positively associated with bilateral trade. For pairs in which both countries have hosted, the matching estimate corresponds to a long-run trade difference with an implied increase of approximately 15 times relative to matched nonhost pairs. Under an assumed trade elasticity of 4, this estimate corresponds to an illustrative trade-cost equivalent of approximately 50%.
title: The Olympic effect revisited: 1950–2019

abstract: Irregular migration to Europe by sea, though risky, remains one of the most popular migration options for many Sub-Saharan Africans. This study examines the drivers of irregular migration decisions using an incentivized lab-in-the-field experiment in rural Gambia, the African country with the highest per-capita rate of irregular migration to Europe. Potential migrants substantially overestimate the probability of dying en route, reporting an average belief of 51 percent compared with a best available estimate of about 20 percent. In the experiment, reducing the probability of dying en route from 50 to 20 percent raises willingness to migrate irregularly by 3.0 percentage points, while reducing the probability of obtaining legal residence from 50 to 30 percent lowers it by 2.1 points. Our results highlight the importance of potential migrants’ prior beliefs in shaping responses to information and suggest that information policies that fail to account for these beliefs may backfire.
title: Why do people migrate irregularly? Evidence from a lab-in-the-field experiment in West Africa

abstract: Given the increasingly severe challenges of global warming and energy security, it is urgent to explore and clarify the mechanisms and pathways for the integrated development of coal power and renewable energy generation under the coupling of electricity, carbon, and green certificate markets. A differential game model is developed for a coal power enterprise and a renewable energy generator within an integrated energy group. The model incorporates the dynamic accumulation of CO2 emission reduction technology knowledge and compares four governance modes: centralized decision making, decentralized decision making, cost sharing contract and profit-sharing contract. The results show that the cost sharing contract performs best in both environmental and economic terms. It produces the highest cumulative CO2 emission reduction and the highest total system profit among the four modes. In the early stage of transition, a policy mix with a relatively high carbon quota and a relatively low renewable portfolio standard generates higher total profits, but this result should be interpreted as a transitional buffer rather than a reason for delaying stricter low carbon policies. Under the cost sharing contract, the coal power enterprise reaches the highest levels of emission reduction innovation investment and renewable capacity installation investment. Under the profit-sharing contract, renewable capacity installation becomes more attractive only when the renewable portfolio standard is high. The analysis of contract parameters further indicates that a higher cost sharing proportion for emission reduction innovation and a moderate cost sharing proportion for renewable capacity investment can support complementary cooperation, while an excessively high sharing burden may erode cooperation gains. These findings provide implications for designing coordinated market rules and contract mechanisms during China's power sector transition.
abstract_zh: 在全球变暖与能源安全挑战日益严峻的背景下，亟需探究并阐明电力、碳与绿证市场耦合下煤电与可再生能源发电融合发展的机制与路径。本文构建了综合能源集团内煤电企业与可再生能源发电商之间的微分博弈模型，将CO2减排技术知识的动态积累纳入其中，并比较了四种治理模式：集中决策、分散决策、成本分摊契约与利润共享契约。结果表明，成本分摊契约在环境与经济两方面表现最佳，在四种模式中产生最高的累计CO2减排量和最高的系统总利润。在转型初期，相对较高的碳配额与相对较低的可再生能源配额制所构成的政策组合能带来更高的总利润，但这一结果应被理解为过渡性缓冲，而非推迟更严格低碳政策的理由。在成本分摊契约下，煤电企业的减排创新投资与可再生能源装机投资均达到最高水平。在利润共享契约下，只有当可再生能源配额制较高时，可再生能源装机才更具吸引力。对契约参数的进一步分析表明，较高的减排创新成本分摊比例与适度的可再生能源装机成本分摊比例能够支撑互补合作，而过高的分摊负担则可能侵蚀合作收益。这些发现为中国电力部门转型期间设计协调的市场规则与契约机制提供了启示。

abstract: Disruptions in global fertilizer markets and climate targets have increased interest in fossil‐free mineral nitrogen fertilizers. This study examines farmers' preferences for conventional (fossil‐based) and fossil‐free fertilizers using a labeled discrete choice experiment with 211 Swedish farmers. Results show that farmers have strong price sensitivity and, on average, are willing to pay a premium for Swedish and European‐produced fertilizers, while the climate attribute plays a smaller role in choices than price and production origin. We identify two segments: a larger group that places strong emphasis on price and Swedish production, and a smaller group characterized by greater price sensitivity. Social and economic identities are associated with preference heterogeneity. Findings suggest that policies promoting fossil‐free fertilizers may receive greater farmer acceptance when aligned with domestic production strategies and targeted price incentives.
abstract_zh: 全球肥料市场的中断以及气候目标提升了人们对无化石矿物氮肥的关注。本研究采用标记离散选择实验，以211名瑞典农民为对象，考察了农民对常规（基于化石燃料）肥料和无化石肥料的偏好。结果表明，农民具有强烈的价格敏感性，平均而言，他们愿意为瑞典和欧洲生产的肥料支付溢价，而气候属性在选择中的作用小于价格和生产来源。我们识别出两个群体：一个较大的群体高度重视价格和瑞典生产，另一个较小的群体则以更高的价格敏感性为特征。社会和经济身份与偏好异质性相关。研究结果表明，当促进无化石肥料的政策与国内生产战略相一致并辅以有针对性的价格激励时，可能更容易获得农民的接受。
title: Farmers' Preferences for Fossil‐Free Mineral Nitrogen Fertilizers: Role of Prices, Climate, Production Origin, and Identity
title_zh: 农民对无化石矿物氮肥的偏好：价格、气候、生产来源和身份的作用

abstract: Drought can impose development costs that are not fully captured by income, production, or formal water access indicators. This paper examines one such hidden cost in Sub-Saharan Africa by focusing on women’s time poverty arising from household water collection. Combining harmonized Demographic and Health Surveys with geocoded drought exposure measured at the survey cluster level, we estimate how local drought conditions are associated with women’s annual water collection burden and broader household adjustments. We find that drought exposure is associated with higher water-collection time for women, with larger estimated increases among women living in poor households, women with no formal education, and women living in households without piped-water access. Intermediate-outcome evidence shows that drought is associated with lower local water availability and a higher likelihood of very long collection trips, particularly journeys exceeding 60 minutes. These water-time burdens are also associated with greater engagement in flexible, household-based, family-based, and self-employed forms of work among women rather than with a simple expansion of protected paid employment. In addition, higher community water burdens are associated with poorer schooling outcomes among girls, including a greater likelihood of being out of school and larger grade-for-age gaps. Household-linked evidence further shows that poorer girls’ schooling outcomes are associated with larger household shares of adult women in unpaid or in-kind work, self-employment, and family work. The findings suggest that drought-related water insecurity can redistribute adaptation costs within households, making women’s unpaid time a key margin through which climate stress produces hidden development costs.
abstract_zh: 干旱可能带来收入、生产或正式用水获取指标未能充分反映的发展成本。本文通过聚焦家庭取水导致的女性时间贫困，考察撒哈拉以南非洲的一项此类隐性成本。我们将协调后的人口与健康调查数据与在调查集群层面测量的地理编码干旱暴露相结合，估计当地干旱状况如何与女性年度取水负担及更广泛的家庭调整相关联。我们发现，干旱暴露与女性取水时间增加相关，且估计增幅在贫困家庭女性、未接受正规教育的女性以及无法获得管道供水的家庭女性中更大。中间结果证据表明，干旱与当地可用水量减少以及超长取水行程的可能性上升相关，尤其是超过60分钟的行程。这些取水时间负担还与女性更多从事灵活、以家庭为基础、以家族为基础以及自雇形式的工作相关，而不是与受保护有偿就业的简单扩张相关。此外，更高的社区取水负担与女孩更差的教育结果相关，包括失学可能性更高以及年龄-年级差距更大。与家庭相关的证据进一步表明，较贫困女孩更差的教育结果与家庭中成年女性从事无酬或实物性工作、自雇和家庭工作的比例更高相关。研究结果表明，与干旱相关的缺水不安全可能在家庭内部重新分配适应成本，使女性的无酬时间成为气候压力产生隐性发展成本的关键边际。
title: Drought, women’s time poverty, and the development costs of water collection in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 干旱、女性时间贫困与撒哈拉以南非洲取水的发展成本

abstract: Measuring tax evasion by firms is notoriously difficult: direct questions yield biased responses while administrative data captures only detected violations. This paper examines the prevalence of reported tax non-compliance in Indonesia through a randomized, double-list experiment embedded in a nationally representative survey of 2,955 registered firms that preserves anonymity. The results indicate that around one-quarter of firms indirectly report not paying all taxes they are required to pay. An indicative back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the associated revenue losses could be economically meaningful, in the order of two percent of GDP. Heterogeneity analyses suggest higher reported non-compliance among firms that do not export, face informal-sector competition, and view tax administration as a major obstacle. These findings help inform tax authorities, which face substantial challenges in estimating levels of tax evasion and identifying non-compliant taxpayers, by providing the first representative estimates of firm tax evasion in a major middle-income country.
abstract_zh: 衡量企业逃税问题向来极为困难：直接提问会得到有偏的回答，而行政数据只能捕捉到已被查处的违法行为。本文通过在印度尼西亚一项具有全国代表性的调查中嵌入随机双列表实验，考察了申报税收不遵从行为的普遍程度。该调查涵盖2，955家注册企业，并保障了匿名性。结果表明，约四分之一的企业间接报告未缴纳其应缴的全部税款。一项指示性的粗略估算显示，相关的税收损失可能具有经济意义，约为GDP的2%。异质性分析表明，在非出口企业、面临非正规部门竞争的企业以及将税收征管视为主要障碍的企业中，申报的不遵从程度更高。这些发现有助于为税务部门提供参考——税务部门在估算逃税水平和识别不遵从纳税人方面面临重大挑战——因为它们首次提供了一个主要中等收入国家具有代表性的企业逃税估计。

title: Revealing tax evasion: Experimental evidence from a representative survey of Indonesian firms

abstract: This study examines the evolution of overqualification across 28 European countries and investigates the macroeconomic and labour market factors shaping its persistence and cross-country differences. Using the Phillips–Sul club convergence methodology, we show that young workers in Europe exhibit multiple convergence paths, while experienced workers tend to converge towards a common equilibrium. We then identify the characteristics associated with convergence club membership using an ordered probit model and examine the short-run determinants of overqualification through a System GMM dynamic panel framework with regional interactions. The results highlight substantial heterogeneity across European labour markets: overqualification is persistent over time, and the effects of unemployment and unemployment benefits on skill mismatch vary between northern and peripheral European economies. These findings suggest that overqualification is shaped not only by individual characteristics but also by labour market institutions and macroeconomic conditions, with important implications for education, employment, and skills-matching policies in Europe.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了28个欧洲国家过度资格的演变，并探讨了塑造其持续性与跨国差异的宏观经济和劳动力市场因素。我们采用Phillips–Sul俱乐部收敛方法，表明欧洲年轻劳动者呈现出多条收敛路径，而经验丰富的劳动者则倾向于收敛至一个共同均衡。随后，我们使用有序probit模型识别与收敛俱乐部归属相关的特征，并通过带有区域交互项的系统GMM动态面板框架考察过度资格的短期决定因素。结果凸显了欧洲劳动力市场之间的显著异质性：过度资格随时间具有持续性，失业和失业救济对技能错配的影响在北欧与欧洲外围经济体之间有所不同。这些发现表明，过度资格不仅由个体特征塑造，也受劳动力市场制度和宏观经济条件影响，对欧洲的教育、就业和技能匹配政策具有重要意义。
title: Overqualification in European Labour Markets: Club Convergence and Its Determinants
title_zh: 欧洲劳动力市场中的过度资历：俱乐部收敛及其决定因素

abstract: Labor agglomeration is an essential driver of urban economies, yet administrative fragmentation has often constrained its efficiency. City Cluster Development Strategies (CCDS) have reshaped the dynamics of labor concentration, but how this reorganized labor agglomeration translates into low-carbon transitions remains underexplored. Using panel data from 210 cities within CCDS from 2008 to 2022 in China, this study constructs a spatially aware labor agglomeration index and employs fixed-effect models to examine its impact on decarbonization. The results reveal that a 10% increase in agglomeration reduces carbon intensity by 1.85%. This effect is more pronounced in regions with advanced urbanization, favorable human capital structures, inter-provincial city clusters, and late-developing cities. Mechanism analysis reveals that labor concentration drives decarbonization by optimizing industrial structures, fostering green innovation, and enhancing scale economies. These findings highlight how unlocking the structural dividend of demographic agglomeration can advance low-carbon development and inform other regions pursuing sustainable urban transitions.
abstract_zh: 劳动力集聚是城市经济的重要驱动力，但行政分割往往制约其效率。城市群发展战略重塑了劳动力集聚的动态，然而这种重组后的劳动力集聚如何转化为低碳转型仍缺乏深入探讨。本研究利用2008年至2022年中国城市群发展战略内210个城市的面板数据，构建了具有空间意识的劳动力集聚指数，并采用固定效应模型考察其对脱碳的影响。结果表明，集聚程度每提高10%，碳强度下降1.85%。这一效应在城镇化水平较高、人力资本结构有利、跨省城市群以及后发城市中更为显著。机制分析表明，劳动力集聚通过优化产业结构、促进绿色创新和增强规模经济来推动脱碳。这些发现凸显了释放人口集聚的结构性红利如何能够推进低碳发展，并为其他寻求可持续城市转型的地区提供借鉴。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Labor agglomeration and low-carbon transition: Evidence from China’s city cluster development strategies
title_zh: 劳动力集聚与低碳转型：来自中国城市群发展战略的证据

abstract: In a stable matching problem, n agents on one side have individual preferences for n agents on another side as a potential match. A matching is called stable if no two unmatched agents prefer each other to their matches. Knuth demonstrated existence of preferences with exponentially many stable matchings, posing a question on expected number of stable matchings for a uniformly random problem instance. Using Knuth’s integral formula, the first author showed that this expectation is quite moderate, asymptotic to $$e^{-1}n\log n$$ , n being the number of agents on each side. In this paper, relaxing stability notion, we declare matching stable if no unmatched pair of agents strongly prefer each other to their partners, with “strength” measured by a parameter $$\varepsilon >0$$ , $$\varepsilon =0$$ corresponding to classic stability. The expected number of $$\varepsilon $$ -stable matchings is proved to be polynomially large if $$\varepsilon $$ of order $$n^{-1}\log n$$ , but it explodes to become super-polynomially large once $$\varepsilon \gg n^{-1}\log n$$ .
abstract_zh: 在一个稳定匹配问题中，一侧的n个代理对另一侧的n个代理作为潜在匹配对象各有偏好。如果没有一对未匹配的代理彼此都更偏好对方而非各自的匹配对象，则称该匹配是稳定的。Knuth证明了存在具有指数多个稳定匹配的偏好，并提出了关于均匀随机问题实例中稳定匹配期望数量的问题。利用Knuth的积分公式，第一作者证明了该期望相当温和，渐近于$$e^{-1}n\log n$$，其中n为每一侧的代理数量。在本文中，我们放松稳定性概念，若没有未匹配的代理对彼此强烈偏好对方而非其搭档，则称匹配是稳定的，其中“强度”由参数$$\varepsilon >0$$衡量，$$\varepsilon =0$$对应于经典稳定性。当$$\varepsilon $$为$$n^{-1}\log n$$阶时，$$\varepsilon $$-稳定匹配的期望数量被证明为多项式规模；但一旦$$\varepsilon \gg n^{-1}\log n$$，该数量便爆炸性地增长为超多项式规模。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Stable matchings under relaxed random preferences
title_zh: 松弛随机偏好下的稳定匹配

abstract: How should unemployment insurance (UI) be designed? We characterize the optimal contract when employability is statistically assessed at the beginning of a claim and progressively revised based on elapsed job search duration. In our setting, workers can manipulate future assessments through current search behavior, generating endogenous learning rents that must be compensated to sustain search effort. We show that these rents increase with unemployment duration and UI generosity, raising the relative attractiveness of search monitoring and assistance. Ignoring learning rents may therefore lead to insufficient search incentives, lower job-finding rates, and biased estimates of the returns to search-incentivizing programs.
abstract_zh: 失业保险应如何设计？我们刻画了在索赔开始时对就业能力进行统计评估、并依据已发生的求职持续时间逐步修正时的最优合同。在我们的设定中，劳动者可以通过当前求职行为操纵未来评估，从而产生内生的学习租金，必须对这些租金予以补偿以维持求职努力。我们表明，这些租金随失业持续时间和失业保险慷慨程度而上升，从而提高求职监督与求职援助的相对吸引力。因此，忽视学习租金可能导致求职激励不足、求职成功率下降，并造成对求职激励项目回报的估计偏误。
title: Optimal unemployment insurance under statistical profiling
title_zh: 统计画像下的最优失业保险

abstract: Using Chicago Mercantile Exchange intraday data in 2024, this paper examines price discovery between agricultural futures and options. Options respond faster to new information, whereas futures contribute more to the efficient price shared by both markets. We provide a market microstructure explanation for this pattern. We find a 1 per cent increase in options’ relative aggressive quoting, defined as quotes that move the best bid or offer price, is associated with a 0.25 per cent increase in their relative speed of price adjustment and a 0.15 per cent decline in their relative contribution to the efficient price. By contrast, options’ relative trading volume is negatively associated with their speed advantage and is unrelated to their contribution to the efficient price. These findings highlight the distinct roles of quoting and trading in cross-market price discovery.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2024年芝加哥商品交易所的日内数据，考察农产品期货与期权之间的价格发现。期权对新信息反应更快，而期货对两个市场共享的有效价格贡献更大。我们为这一模式提供了市场微观结构解释。我们发现，期权相对激进报价——定义为推动最优买价或卖价的报价——每增加1%，其相对价格调整速度提高0.25%，其对有效价格的相对贡献下降0.15%。相比之下，期权的相对交易量与速度优势负相关，且与其对有效价格的贡献无关。这些发现凸显了报价和交易在跨市场价格发现中的不同作用。
title: Quoting behavior and price discovery in agricultural derivatives markets
title_zh: 农产品衍生品市场中的报价行为与价格发现

abstract: We study how interbank funding links monetary policy transmission to systemic risk in a banking system with heterogeneous access to deposit funding. Using bank-level data from China, we show that monetary policy easing reallocates liquidity through the interbank market: large banks raise household demand deposits and lend in the interbank market, while small banks expand loans through interbank borrowing. During economic downturns, greater reliance on interbank funding is associated with higher systemic risk. To interpret these facts, we build a structural model with deposit-rich and deposit-poor banks and interbank rollover risk. The model shows that monetary policy easing reallocates liquidity and boosts lending, but also raises run risk. It reveals a macroprudential trade-off: a regulatory limit on interbank funding weakens monetary policy transmission but reduces systemic risk.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在存款融资渠道存在异质性的银行体系中，银行间融资如何将货币政策传导与系统性风险联系起来。基于中国银行层面数据，我们表明货币政策宽松通过银行间市场重新配置流动性：大型银行吸收家庭活期存款并在银行间市场放贷，而小型银行则通过银行间借款扩大贷款。在经济下行期，对银行间融资依赖程度越高，系统性风险越高。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个包含存款充裕型银行与存款匮乏型银行以及银行间展期风险的结构模型。该模型表明，货币政策宽松会重新配置流动性并促进贷款，但也会提高挤兑风险。它揭示了一个宏观审慎权衡：对银行间融资实施监管限制会削弱货币政策传导，但会降低系统性风险。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: A trade-off between monetary policy transmission and systemic risk
title_zh: 货币政策传导与系统性风险之间的权衡

abstract: This paper studies the moral roots of climate policy attitudes. We fielded a survey with a representative sample in the US to study the predictive power of moral universalism in explaining heterogeneity in specific climate policy attitudes. Our results reveal that universalism is significantly related to support for various policy measures that prevail in current policy debates in most countries, including domestic policies such as a carbon tax and a green infrastructure program, as well as international policies such as international burden-sharing. Supporting evidence comes from simple bystander allocation decisions in which respondents are asked to decide “who should pay” to fight climate change or to mitigate the adverse consequences of global warming. Open-text elicitations further corroborate these results and identify moral universalism as a key aspect of how people reason about climate policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究气候政策态度的道德根源。我们在美国开展了一项具有代表性样本的调查，以研究道德普遍主义在解释特定气候政策态度异质性方面的预测能力。我们的结果揭示，普遍主义与对多数国家当前政策辩论中流行的各种政策措施的支持显著相关，这些措施包括碳税和绿色基础设施项目等国内政策，以及国际负担分担等国际政策。支持性证据来自简单的旁观者分配决策，即要求受访者决定“谁应该支付”以应对气候变化或减缓全球变暖的不利后果。开放式文本引述进一步佐证了这些结果，并确认道德普遍主义是人们推理气候政策方式的一个关键方面。
title: Morality and climate policy attitudes

abstract: Across food, tourism, cosmetics, and luxury goods, indigenous language and heritage increasingly anchor premium market positions, but when it comes to trademarks, few jurisdictions have developed national rules to explicitly protect and preserve traditional knowledge. This column looks at the case of New Zealand, where the Māori Advisory Committee advises the Commissioner of Trademarks on whether registration of a trademark incorporating Māori signs is likely to be offensive to Māori. This embedded collective governance mechanism raises the cost of new entry in New Zealand but increases the value of existing trademarks held there.
abstract_zh: 在食品、旅游、化妆品和奢侈品领域，原住民语言与遗产日益成为高端市场定位的支柱，但在商标方面，鲜有司法管辖区制定了明确保护和保存传统知识的国家规则。本专栏考察新西兰的案例，该国设有毛利咨询委员会，就包含毛利标志的商标注册是否可能冒犯毛利人向商标专员提供建议。这一内嵌的集体治理机制提高了在新西兰新进入市场的成本，但提升了在该国已持有商标的价值。
authors: Alexander Cuntz, Alessio Muscarnera, Egbert Amoncio
title: Protecting indigenous cultural resources from within the IP system
title_zh: 在知识产权体系内保护土著文化资源

abstract: Europe's shrinking workforce is weighing on its productivity and welfare systems. Meanwhile, its southern Mediterranean neighbours currently produce growing numbers of graduates whom domestic labour markets cannot absorb. This column makes the case for a Mediterranean Community of Human Capital, built around joint investment in training, skills, and mobility, which could expand the skills base, reduce brain drain, and rebuild trust with Europe’s closest neighbours.
abstract_zh: 欧洲劳动力萎缩正对其生产率和福利体系构成压力。与此同时，其南地中海邻国目前培养出越来越多的毕业生，而国内劳动力市场却无法吸纳。本专栏主张建立一个地中海人力资本共同体，围绕培训、技能和流动性的联合投资来构建，这可以扩大技能基础、减少人才外流，并重建欧洲与其最近邻国之间的信任。
title: A Mediterranean Community of Human Capital
title_zh: 地中海人力资本共同体

abstract: Persistent deviations from the covered interest parity no-arbitrage condition are viewed as evidence of the new and central role of balance sheet constraints and financial market frictions since the Global Financial Crisis. This column argues that covered interest parity deviations are not a recent phenomenon. Deviations have been the norm over the past 60 years, with the notable exception of the years immediately preceding the crisis, when the condition held unusually closely. Furthermore, financial market frictions are not unique to the post-Global Financial Crisis era, but a persistent feature of foreign exchange and money markets over the longer run.
abstract_zh: 持续偏离抛补利率平价无套利条件被视为全球金融危机以来资产负债表约束与金融市场摩擦发挥新的核心作用的证据。本专栏认为，抛补利率平价偏离并非近期现象。过去60年间，偏离一直是常态，显著的例外是危机前数年，当时该条件异常紧密地成立。此外，金融市场摩擦并非全球金融危机后时期所独有，而是外汇与货币市场在更长期内的持续特征。
authors: Olivier Accominotti, Jason Cen, David Chambers, Victor Degorce
title: Covered interest parity deviations and financial market frictions: Six decades of evidence
title_zh: 抵补利率平价偏离与金融市场摩擦：六十年证据

abstract: We experimentally study sequential rationality in the Game of Chomp, a two-player win-lose game whose rules are simple but whose subgame-perfect Nash equilibria vary in complexity across initial states. Subjects frequently deviate from SPNE: the probability of making an SPNE-consistent move falls with the distance to the end of the game, and most can correctly implement SPNE only three to five moves ahead. Experience mainly improves play at intermediate distances. We also document a common opening heuristic that, although often theoretically suboptimal, is still associated with higher chances of winning.
abstract_zh: 我们在“巧克力游戏”（Game of Chomp）中实验研究序贯理性。该游戏为双人胜负游戏，规则简单，但其子博弈精炼纳什均衡（SPNE）在不同初始状态下复杂度各异。被试经常偏离SPNE：走出与SPNE一致之着法的概率随距游戏终局的距离增加而下降，且多数被试仅能正确执行前方三至五步的SPNE。经验主要改善中等距离处的博弈表现。我们还记录了一种常见的开局启发式，尽管其在理论上往往并非最优，却仍与更高的获胜概率相关。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Finite foresight in Chomp

abstract: Development accounting is the search for proximate sources of cross-country income differences. This article describes how knowledge in this field has evolved over the two decades since the influential work of Caselli (2005). There have been large advances in the measurement of production inputs (labor, physical capital, and human capital). These advances have raised the estimated contribution of inputs, mostly human capital, in development accounting. Our preferred estimate is that inputs account for 55–70 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) per worker differences, versus 30 percent using the classic specification. The literature has also made progress in moving away from Cobb-Douglas production functions and measuring factors such as management quality that were previously bundled into total factor productivity (TFP). Our review highlights the new implications of these advances, areas where future research would be beneficial, and the limitations of development accounting.
title: Accounting for Cross-Country Income Differences Revisited
